sections.explanation: Similar triangles have equal corresponding angles and proportional sides. A right triangle satisfies a²+b²=c². Circle area is πr², circumference 2πr, and cylinder volume πr²h. A radian is arc length divided by radius: θ=s/r; 180°=π radians. On the unit circle cosθ is the horizontal coordinate and sinθ the vertical coordinate. Thus sin²θ+cos²θ=1 and tanθ=sinθ/cosθ where cosθ≠0. For other triangles, a/sinA=b/sinB and c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC; label opposite sides carefully.
